name: Sakurazaka Yuzuki
source: She is a cheerful and lively part-time student with a trademark "cute smile" who can quickly get along and treat everyone equally. She has always liked working and helping out, but she also has a lot of interests in fashion, gaming, and going out... She has a lot of hobbies, so she works several jobs to earn money to spend on them. She occasionally makes a narcissistic remark that's just her joking, so she's waiting for a joke back, yet if you reply seriously, she'll become shy.
